codes.name: UNKNOWN_SERVER_ERROR
codes.description: The server experienced an unexpected error when processing the request.

codes.name: OFFSET_OUT_OF_RANGE
codes.description: The requested offset is not within the range of offsets maintained by the server.

codes.name: CORRUPT_MESSAGE
codes.description: This message has failed its CRC checksum, exceeds the valid size, has a null key for a compacted topic, or is otherwise corrupt.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION
codes.description: This server does not host this topic-partition.

codes.name: INVALID_FETCH_SIZE
codes.description: The requested fetch size is invalid.

codes.name: LEADER_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: There is no leader for this topic-partition as we are in the middle of a leadership election.

codes.name: NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER
codes.description: For requests intended only for the leader, this error indicates that the broker is not the current leader. For requests intended for any replica, this error indicates that the broker is not a replica of the topic partition.

codes.name: REQUEST_TIMED_OUT
codes.description: The request timed out.

codes.name: BROKER_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: The broker is not available.

codes.name: REPLICA_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: The replica is not available for the requested topic-partition. Produce/Fetch requests and other requests intended only for the leader or follower return NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER if the broker is not a replica of the topic-partition.

codes.name: MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE
codes.description: The request included a message larger than the max message size the server will accept.

codes.name: STALE_CONTROLLER_EPOCH
codes.description: The controller moved to another broker.

codes.name: OFFSET_METADATA_TOO_LARGE
codes.description: The metadata field of the offset request was too large.

codes.name: NETWORK_EXCEPTION
codes.description: The server disconnected before a response was received.

codes.name: COORDINATOR_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS
codes.description: The coordinator is loading and hence can't process requests.

codes.name: COORDINATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: The coordinator is not available.

codes.name: NOT_COORDINATOR
codes.description: This is not the correct coordinator.

codes.name: INVALID_TOPIC_EXCEPTION
codes.description: The request attempted to perform an operation on an invalid topic.

codes.name: RECORD_LIST_TOO_LARGE
codes.description: The request included message batch larger than the configured segment size on the server.

codes.name: NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS
codes.description: Messages are rejected since there are fewer in-sync replicas than required.

codes.name: NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS_AFTER_APPEND
codes.description: Messages are written to the log, but to fewer in-sync replicas than required.

codes.name: INVALID_REQUIRED_ACKS
codes.description: Produce request specified an invalid value for required acks.

codes.name: ILLEGAL_GENERATION
codes.description: Specified group generation id is not valid.

codes.name: INCONSISTENT_GROUP_PROTOCOL
codes.description: The group member's supported protocols are incompatible with those of existing members or first group member tried to join with empty protocol type or empty protocol list.

codes.name: INVALID_GROUP_ID
codes.description: The configured groupId is invalid.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_MEMBER_ID
codes.description: The coordinator is not aware of this member.

codes.name: INVALID_SESSION_TIMEOUT
codes.description: The session timeout is not within the range allowed by the broker (as configured by group.min.session.timeout.ms and group.max.session.timeout.ms).

codes.name: REBALANCE_IN_PROGRESS
codes.description: The group is rebalancing, so a rejoin is needed.

codes.name: INVALID_COMMIT_OFFSET_SIZE
codes.description: The committing offset data size is not valid.

codes.name: TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED
codes.description: Topic authorization failed.

codes.name: GROUP_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED
codes.description: Group authorization failed.

codes.name: CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED
codes.description: Cluster authorization failed.

codes.name: INVALID_TIMESTAMP
codes.description: The timestamp of the message is out of acceptable range.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_SASL_MECHANISM
codes.description: The broker does not support the requested SASL mechanism.

codes.name: ILLEGAL_SASL_STATE
codes.description: Request is not valid given the current SASL state.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
codes.description: The version of API is not supported.

codes.name: TOPIC_ALREADY_EXISTS
codes.description: Topic with this name already exists.

codes.name: INVALID_PARTITIONS
codes.description: Number of partitions is below 1.

codes.name: INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR
codes.description: Replication factor is below 1 or larger than the number of available brokers.

codes.name: INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT
codes.description: Replica assignment is invalid.

codes.name: INVALID_CONFIG
codes.description: Configuration is invalid.

codes.name: NOT_CONTROLLER
codes.description: This is not the correct controller for this cluster.

codes.name: INVALID_REQUEST
codes.description: This most likely occurs because of a request being malformed by the client library or the message was sent to an incompatible broker. See the broker logs for more details.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_FOR_MESSAGE_FORMAT
codes.description: The message format version on the broker does not support the request.

codes.name: POLICY_VIOLATION
codes.description: Request parameters do not satisfy the configured policy.

codes.name: OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
codes.description: The broker received an out of order sequence number.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
codes.description: The broker received a duplicate sequence number.

codes.name: INVALID_PRODUCER_EPOCH
codes.description: Producer attempted to produce with an old epoch.

codes.name: INVALID_TXN_STATE
codes.description: The producer attempted a transactional operation in an invalid state.

codes.name: INVALID_PRODUCER_ID_MAPPING
codes.description: The producer attempted to use a producer id which is not currently assigned to its transactional id.

codes.name: INVALID_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT
codes.description: The transaction timeout is larger than the maximum value allowed by the broker (as configured by transaction.max.timeout.ms).

codes.name: CONCURRENT_TRANSACTIONS
codes.description: The producer attempted to update a transaction while another concurrent operation on the same transaction was ongoing.

codes.name: TRANSACTION_COORDINATOR_FENCED
codes.description: Indicates that the transaction coordinator sending a WriteTxnMarker is no longer the current coordinator for a given producer.

codes.name: TRANSACTIONAL_ID_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED
codes.description: Transactional Id authorization failed.

codes.name: SECURITY_DISABLED
codes.description: Security features are disabled.

codes.name: OPERATION_NOT_ATTEMPTED
codes.description: The broker did not attempt to execute this operation. This may happen for batched RPCs where some operations in the batch failed, causing the broker to respond without trying the rest.

codes.name: KAFKA_STORAGE_ERROR
codes.description: Disk error when trying to access log file on the disk.

codes.name: LOG_DIR_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The user-specified log directory is not found in the broker config.

codes.name: SASL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
codes.description: SASL Authentication failed.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_PRODUCER_ID
codes.description: This exception is raised by the broker if it could not locate the producer metadata associated with the producerId in question. This could happen if, for instance, the producer's records were deleted because their retention time had elapsed. Once the last records of the producerId are removed, the producer's metadata is removed from the broker, and future appends by the producer will return this exception.

codes.name: REASSIGNMENT_IN_PROGRESS
codes.description: A partition reassignment is in progress.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_AUTH_DISABLED
codes.description: Delegation Token feature is not enabled.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: Delegation Token is not found on server.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH
codes.description: Specified Principal is not valid Owner/Renewer.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_REQUEST_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.description: Delegation Token requests are not allowed on PLAINTEXT/1-way SSL channels and on delegation token authenticated channels.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED
codes.description: Delegation Token authorization failed.

codes.name: DELEGATION_TOKEN_EXPIRED
codes.description: Delegation Token is expired.

codes.name: INVALID_PRINCIPAL_TYPE
codes.description: Supplied principalType is not supported.

codes.name: NON_EMPTY_GROUP
codes.description: The group is not empty.

codes.name: GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The group id does not exist.

codes.name: FETCH_SESSION_ID_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The fetch session ID was not found.

codes.name: INVALID_FETCH_SESSION_EPOCH
codes.description: The fetch session epoch is invalid.

codes.name: LISTENER_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: There is no listener on the leader broker that matches the listener on which metadata request was processed.

codes.name: TOPIC_DELETION_DISABLED
codes.description: Topic deletion is disabled.

codes.name: FENCED_LEADER_EPOCH
codes.description: The leader epoch in the request is older than the epoch on the broker.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_LEADER_EPOCH
codes.description: The leader epoch in the request is newer than the epoch on the broker.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_COMPRESSION_TYPE
codes.description: The requesting client does not support the compression type of given partition.

codes.name: STALE_BROKER_EPOCH
codes.description: Broker epoch has changed.

codes.name: OFFSET_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: The leader high watermark has not caught up from a recent leader election so the offsets cannot be guaranteed to be monotonically increasing.

codes.name: MEMBER_ID_REQUIRED
codes.description: The group member needs to have a valid member id before actually entering a consumer group.

codes.name: PREFERRED_LEADER_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: The preferred leader was not available.

codes.name: GROUP_MAX_SIZE_REACHED
codes.description: The consumer group has reached its max size.

codes.name: FENCED_INSTANCE_ID
codes.description: The broker rejected this static consumer since another consumer with the same group.instance.id has registered with a different member.id.

codes.name: ELIGIBLE_LEADERS_NOT_AVAILABLE
codes.description: Eligible topic partition leaders are not available.

codes.name: ELECTION_NOT_NEEDED
codes.description: Leader election not needed for topic partition.

codes.name: NO_REASSIGNMENT_IN_PROGRESS
codes.description: No partition reassignment is in progress.

codes.name: GROUP_SUBSCRIBED_TO_TOPIC
codes.description: Deleting offsets of a topic is forbidden while the consumer group is actively subscribed to it.

codes.name: INVALID_RECORD
codes.description: This record has failed the validation on broker and hence will be rejected.

codes.name: UNSTABLE_OFFSET_COMMIT
codes.description: There are unstable offsets that need to be cleared.

codes.name: THROTTLING_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
codes.description: The throttling quota has been exceeded.

codes.name: PRODUCER_FENCED
codes.description: There is a newer producer with the same transactionalId which fences the current one.

codes.name: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: A request illegally referred to a resource that does not exist.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_RESOURCE
codes.description: A request illegally referred to the same resource twice.

codes.name: UNACCEPTABLE_CREDENTIAL
codes.description: Requested credential would not meet criteria for acceptability.

codes.name: INCONSISTENT_VOTER_SET
codes.description: Indicates that the either the sender or recipient of a voter-only request is not one of the expected voters

codes.name: INVALID_UPDATE_VERSION
codes.description: The given update version was invalid.

codes.name: FEATURE_UPDATE_FAILED
codes.description: Unable to update finalized features due to an unexpected server error.

codes.name: PRINCIPAL_DESERIALIZATION_FAILURE
codes.description: Request principal deserialization failed during forwarding. This indicates an internal error on the broker cluster security setup.

codes.name: SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: Requested snapshot was not found

codes.name: POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE
codes.description: Requested position is not greater than or equal to zero, and less than the size of the snapshot.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID
codes.description: This server does not host this topic ID.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_BROKER_REGISTRATION
codes.description: This broker ID is already in use.

codes.name: BROKER_ID_NOT_REGISTERED
codes.description: The given broker ID was not registered.

codes.name: INCONSISTENT_TOPIC_ID
codes.description: The log's topic ID did not match the topic ID in the request

codes.name: INCONSISTENT_CLUSTER_ID
codes.description: The clusterId in the request does not match that found on the server

codes.name: TRANSACTIONAL_ID_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The transactionalId could not be found

codes.name: FETCH_SESSION_TOPIC_ID_ERROR
codes.description: The fetch session encountered inconsistent topic ID usage

codes.name: INELIGIBLE_REPLICA
codes.description: The new ISR contains at least one ineligible replica.

codes.name: NEW_LEADER_ELECTED
codes.description: The AlterPartition request successfully updated the partition state but the leader has changed.

codes.name: OFFSET_MOVED_TO_TIERED_STORAGE
codes.description: The requested offset is moved to tiered storage.

codes.name: FENCED_MEMBER_EPOCH
codes.description: The member epoch is fenced by the group coordinator. The member must abandon all its partitions and rejoin.

codes.name: UNRELEASED_INSTANCE_ID
codes.description: The instance ID is still used by another member in the consumer group. That member must leave first.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_ASSIGNOR
codes.description: The assignor or its version range is not supported by the consumer group.

codes.name: STALE_MEMBER_EPOCH
codes.description: The member epoch is stale. The member must retry after receiving its updated member epoch via the ConsumerGroupHeartbeat API.

codes.name: MISMATCHED_ENDPOINT_TYPE
codes.description: The request was sent to an endpoint of the wrong type.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_ENDPOINT_TYPE
codes.description: This endpoint type is not supported yet.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_CONTROLLER_ID
codes.description: This controller ID is not known.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
codes.description: Client sent a push telemetry request with an invalid or outdated subscription ID.

codes.name: TELEMETRY_TOO_LARGE
codes.description: Client sent a push telemetry request larger than the maximum size the broker will accept.

codes.name: INVALID_REGISTRATION
codes.description: The controller has considered the broker registration to be invalid.

codes.name: TRANSACTION_ABORTABLE
codes.description: The server encountered an error with the transaction. The client can abort the transaction to continue using this transactional ID.

codes.name: INVALID_RECORD_STATE
codes.description: The record state is invalid. The acknowledgement of delivery could not be completed.

codes.name: SHARE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The share session was not found.

codes.name: INVALID_SHARE_SESSION_EPOCH
codes.description: The share session epoch is invalid.

codes.name: FENCED_STATE_EPOCH
codes.description: The share coordinator rejected the request because the share-group state epoch did not match.

codes.name: INVALID_VOTER_KEY
codes.description: The voter key doesn't match the receiving replica's key.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_VOTER
codes.description: The voter is already part of the set of voters.

codes.name: VOTER_NOT_FOUND
codes.description: The voter is not part of the set of voters.

codes.name: INVALID_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
codes.description: The regular expression is not valid.

codes.name: REBOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED
codes.description: Client metadata is stale, client should rebootstrap to obtain new metadata.

codes.name: STREAMS_INVALID_TOPOLOGY
codes.description: The supplied topology is invalid.

codes.name: STREAMS_INVALID_TOPOLOGY_EPOCH
codes.description: The supplied topology epoch is invalid.

codes.name: STREAMS_TOPOLOGY_FENCED
codes.description: The supplied topology epoch is outdated.

codes.name: SHARE_SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED
codes.description: The limit of share sessions has been reached.
